How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
In-stock orders typically process and ship within 1–2 business days. Once your order ships, a tracking number is automatically sent to your email.
Custom tile orders have longer lead times—typically 12–14 weeks—as they are made to order. Delivery transit times after shipment can vary depending on your location and whether your order ships via standard carrier or freight.

Once it ships, how long is delivery?
menu
Delivery transit times depend on the shipping method and destination:
Smaller orders (typically 1–2 boxes) or samples ship via UPS Ground and usually arrive within a few business days (for example, 2–4 business days depending on location).
Larger orders (3 boxes or more) ship via freight/LTL. For freight shipments, the carrier will contact you directly to schedule a curbside delivery appointment.
